title: NLP for Social Good: A Survey and Outlook of Challenges, Opportunities, and Responsible Deployment

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and synthesizing existing datasets, evaluation metrics (e.g., WEAT, coreference resolution gaps, pronoun-drop attribution), and mitigation strategies across static embeddings, dynamic embeddings, and large language models.

Cataloging representative datasets and benchmarks for cross-cultural NLP tasks, tracking evaluation practices like value alignment probing, cultural commonsense QA, and accuracy gaps across geographic regions.
Surveying NLP literature focused on poverty prediction, income classification from text, and the critical lack of socioeconomic class representation in modern language technologies.

Reviewing literature and datasets addressing accessibility needs (e.g., dysarthric speech recognition, sign language translation, text simplification) and summarizing evaluations of implicit model biases against people with disabilities.
